messages:
monitor-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate + tail latency observed for inference requests in us-west-2 AZ az1a. Metric: inference_5xx_rate >= 3% over 2m, p95 latency spike to ~2s. Auto-page: mike_oncall. link: https://graph.redwood/inference/az1a

mike_oncall: I'm on it. pulling perf dashboards now. anyone seeing errors in NLB logs?

emma_ops: I see increased backend connection resets on the gputier-nlb-az1a target group. Common source: ENI egress packets dropping then reconnects.

rajiv_net: running a quick traceroute from a failed node -> shows intermittent packet loss at az1a egress interface to the NAT GW. suspect partial link flap in AZ fabric (not full down).

mike_oncall: can we confirm scope? are we seeing cross-region fallback kicking in? customer reports from eu seem fine.

lynn_platform: early numbers: ~3% of total production inference traffic routed to az1a; degraded path affects ~25% of requests that hit az1a (so ~0.75% overall). But those requests show p95 1.8-2.4s and some 502s.

support_sarah: flagged 2 customers on the busier plans contacting support about timeouts in the last 20m. CS has short summary ready for SRE.

mike_oncall: plan: (1) remove az1a from global LB rotation (Route53/weighted) to shift traffic away, (2) enable NLB connection reset policy to reduce sticky bad conns, (3) scale up eu-west-1 dedicated pool for temporary capacity, (4) if needed drain pods/nodes in az1a. starting step 1 now.

mike_oncall: Route53 change (weighted): set weight us-west-2 az1a -> 0, push 30% to eu-west-1 for warm up, keep remaining on us-west-2 other AZs. TTL 60s.

emma_ops: executing NLB target group update to set deregistration delay 30s and enable proxy protocol off. Also toggling idle timeout to 60s.

rajiv_net: AWS console shows NAT gateway in az1a experiencing high retransmits. I've opened a support case with AWS (case 123456789) asking for network path investigation; asked for escalated P1.

mike_oncall: executing k8s drain on inference-nodes-az1a-ASG one at a time. command: ```kubectl drain inference-az1a-node-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30``` will route pods to eu/other AZs thanks to cross-zone. doing in 2-min cadence.

lynn_platform: rolling drains started. first node drained, traffic redistributed. noticing p95 for az1a tenant slice drop from 2.2s -> 1.1s for remaining nodes but still some 502s from earlier connections.

monitor-bot: NOTE: Canary route shift to eu-west-1 deployed. Observed new capacity warm-up for model-1 and model-2. No errors in eu region.

support_sarah: customer update drafted: "We detected a partial network degradation in one AWS availability zone causing timeouts for a subset of inference requests. We have shifted traffic and are mitigating; we will follow up with post-incident details." Want me to send?

mike_oncall: send now. include known impacted timeframe start=2356009876. assign postmortem owners: rajiv_net + lynn_platform.

rajiv_net: quick mitigation tick: toggled NLB cross-zone load balancing on for the affected target group to smooth sticky session imbalance. That reduced new failure rate to ~0.6% on az1a requests.

emma_ops: observed one worker with stale KV cache references causing additional failures when requests were retried to other nodes. Flushed prefix cache on 3 pods: ```curl -X POST http://admin.internal/flush_cache?prefix=kvcache-model1```

mike_oncall: good catch. monitoring tail now. are we ready to handoff to next oncall in 30m? pagerduty, can you remind schedule?

pagerduty: Handoff reminder: next shift is emma_ops at 2356011400. Manual ack still held by mike_oncall.

mike_oncall: I'm going to escalate to AWS after drains and Route53 shift. leaving notes for emma_ops. summary for handoff: - AWS case open (123456789) - Route53 weight set (TTL 60) - draining nodes in az1a 3/5 complete - NLB idle timeout adjusted - cross-zone LB enabled - customers notified.

emma_ops: taking over. I'll watch metrics and keep AWS case updated. question: do we keep eu-warm path at 30% or ramp down?

lynn_platform: recommend keep eu warm at 20-30% until AWS confirms stable egress in az1a and all drains complete + 15m observation.

support_sarah: CS asking if there was data exfiltration or failed requests with sensitive payloads—any logs indicating leaks?

rajiv_net: no evidence of data exfiltration. Failures are connection resets/timeouts; logs show standard 502/504 without stack traces or payload dumps. I'll provision a conservative audit log export for the window and share.

monitor-bot: UPDATE: 10m after actions - global 5xx rate reduced from 3% -> 0.9%, az1a-specific errors down to 0.4%, p95 trending down to ~700ms.

mike_oncall: nice work. leaving channel. emma, please coordinate final rollback of Route53 weights once AWS confirms fix. postmortem owners: rajiv_net, lynn_platform.

emma_ops: acknowledged. starting post-incident checklist and will include mitigation timeline + RTO/RPO estimations.

mike_oncall: one more note for postmortem: consider adding an automated route-failover playbook to reduce manual Route53 edits (maybe use Lambda-based health checks + auto-weight).

emma_ops: noted. paws for emoji :thumbsup:. closing incident channel for now, will reopen if AWS reports additional failures.

support_sarah: I'll follow up customers with timeline and next steps once final confirmation. thanks team. :heart:
